name: Closing card doubles as a shareable preview
looks: The frame settles into a clean two-column card: the pixel-heart mark and wordmark with a short headline and one line of body copy on the left, a solid colour panel holding a larger version of the same mark on the right, a short closing line and the URL at the bottom.
build: wordmark-assemble's finished-state settle for the mark and headline landing together; the right-hand colour panel and its larger mark fade/scale in on the same beat, so the whole card reads as a single social-preview-style graphic.
sound: A soft confirm tone as the card settles, fading under the URL.
prompt: Close on a card built like a link preview: the brand's mark and a short headline on one side, a bold colour panel repeating the mark at a larger size on the other, with one closing line and the URL anchoring the bottom, so the sign-off doubles as something shareable on its own.
